facts.locator: Current JR Bus Kanto guide identifies Busta Shinjuku boarding/alighting and the JR Shinjuku new-south gate terminal passage. Terminal operator independently confirms the gate connection and an alternate south-gate route. Current notices identify stopped northwest elevator and Miraina-side down escalator but explicitly provide other escalator/elevator routes. Retain bidirectional passenger access only, no unavailable-device, duration or wheelchair-access claim.
